card.name: Numbers inside dose ranges
card.fires_on: The word 'to' or a dash between two numbers in a dose range, or a digit partway through a number, in dosing tables by age or weight.

modes.label: Range joiner
modes.description: 'to' or a dash between the low and high ends of a dose range in an age or weight table.
modes.example: Age Starting Daily Dosage Per Kg Body Weight* 0 to 3 months 10<< to>> 15 mcg/kg/day

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a multi-digit or decimal dose or level.
modes.example: 55 Years of Age: 4<<0>> mg every 10 seconds until induction

card.plain: It fires in the middle of dose numbers and ranges, such as '10 to 15' in pediatric dosing tables.
